title: Senior Technical Recruiter
description:
**About Prodigal**
------------------

Prodigal is the connected AI platform leading financial institutions use to run their operations.

We work with banks, lenders, credit unions, and other financial companies that lend money to people and manage those relationships over time.

These institutions make millions of high-stakes decisions every day. Who should they reach? When should they reach them? What should they say or offer? When should a case move to a human? How should that change based on the borrower, the account, previous interactions, and the regulations involved?

Getting those decisions right requires a deep understanding of the people, processes, rules, and edge cases behind them.

Prodigal has spent the last eight years building that understanding. More than a billion interactions between financial institutions and their customers have shaped the intelligence, guardrails, and AI agents we now run in production across North America.

Today, our AI agents analyze conversations, capture context, guide human agents, decide the next action, conduct customer conversations, orchestrate outreach, and help people complete payments and resolutions. They are connected, so what is learned in one interaction can inform what happens next.

We are expanding this swarm of AI agents across more of the work financial institutions do: originations, document processing, back-office workflows, servicing, and other critical operations where money, identity, people, and regulation intersect.

We are backed by Y Combinator, Accel, and Menlo Ventures, and work with 100+ financial institutions across North America. Listen directly from our CTO, Cofounder - Sangram Raje

  

### **The Role**

As a Senior Technical Recruiter at Prodigal, you will own hiring end to end across both tech and non-tech roles, from understanding what a team needs to getting the right person to say yes. You'll partner closely with hiring managers across Engineering, Product, implementation, and strategy to build the team that builds Prodigal.

You'll have real ownership over how we find, assess and close talent. This is a high-impact role in a fast-growing startup, where every hire shapes the company, and where you'll have the room to sharpen how we recruit, not just run the process.

### **What You'll Own**

**End-to-End Recruitment**

* Own the full recruitment cycle for tech and non-tech roles, from intake to joining.
* Partner with hiring managers to define role requirements, write JDs, and align on what great looks like.
* Manage multiple open roles at once while keeping quality and speed in balance.

**Sourcing & Screening**

* Proactively source candidates through LinkedIn, job boards, referrals, communities, and direct outreach.
* Screen candidates for skills, experience, and culture fit.
* Build talent pipelines/prospect pools for critical and recurring roles, so we are never starting from zero.
* Build genuine, long term relationships with the candidates, staying in touch with strong talent even when there is no immediate role.

**Interviews, Offers & Negotiation**

* Coordinate interview loops, gather timely feedback, and keep the process moving.
* Lead offers conversations and compensation negotiations, and close candidates with confidence.
* Deliver a candidate experience that people talk about afterward, whether or not they join us.

**Pipeline Tracking & Reporting**

* Maintain accurate, up-to-date pipeline data in the ATS and trackers.
* Track and share hiring metrics such as funnel conversion, and source effectiveness.
* Spot gaps in how we hire today and pitch practical fixes, including smarter use of AI tools in recruiting.

### **Who You Are**

* 5+ years of experience in end-to-end recruitment across tech and non-tech roles.
* Must have: proven experience hiring for tech roles, especially in a startup environment.
* Strong sourcing and screening skills, with hands-on experience using LinkedIn Recruiter, job portals, and ATS tools.
* Technical proficiency, an understanding of tech stacks and roles that lets you hold informed conversations with engineers.
* Confident negotiator who can manage offers, compensation discussions, and closures.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, you will be the first impression of Prodigal for every candidate.
* Organized and data-driven, able to manage multiple pipelines without anything slipping through the cracks.

  

### **Top Tier Benefits**

Health insurance for you and your family, meals at office on us, travel reimbursement, unlimited leaves, gym membership, unlimited learning & development, flexible work schedule and a world-class team to learn and grow with!

From day 1, Prodigal has been defined by talented, humble, and hungry leaders and we want this mindset and culture to continue to blossom from top to bottom in the company. If you have an entrepreneurial spirit and want to work in a fast-paced, intellectually-stimulating environment where you will be pushed to grow, then please reach out because we are looking to build a transformational company that reinvents one of the biggest industries in the US.

To learn more about us - please visit the following:

Our Story - https://www.prodigaltech.com/our-story

What shapes our thinking - https://link.prodigaltech.com/our-thesis

Our website - https://www.prodigaltech.com/

description:
**Sarvoham Welfare Trust**

**Position**: Talent Acquisition Specialist and HR Business Partner

**Department:** Human Resources

**Location:** Bangalore, India (On-site)

**Reporting To:** Manager HR Business Partner

**Employment Type:** Full-Time (6-months contract, with scope for extension and absorption)

**ABOUT SARVOHAM:**

Sarvoham Welfare Trust is a charitable organization dedicated to the welfare of under-privileged animals in Bangalore, India. Sarvoham was established in April 2017 by co-founders Haris Ali & Madhusmita Sahu with a vision to create an inclusive eco-system that co-exists with animals providing them a respectable life that contributes to the Environmental, Social and Governance (ESG) frameworks and Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs’) for the planet.

Over the past 9 years, Sarvoham has grown from a small charity effort to a well-established animal welfare organization. We have rescued more than 3500 street animals, and provide a shelter for more than 200 dogs.

Sarvoham means the harmony between all elements of nature, both human and non-human, and the organization is guided by the spirit of harmonious coexistence.

**ROLE PURPOSE:**

Sarvoham stands at a defining moment in its journey to create a more compassionate world for animals and seeks to expand its impact by building a sustainable ecosystem of partnerships and philanthropy that will enable many more lives to be saved and transformed.

The Talent Acquisition Specialist & HR Business Partner is a key role responsible for building the Foundation's internal & external ecosystem of partnerships, influence, and trust The core objective is to position Sarvoham as a sustainable and trusted partner integrating attracting the best fit talent for the foundation to supporting the employee lifecycle with community mobilization, public communications, advocacy, and brand stewardship into a unified strategy that advances the Foundation's mission and long-term sustainability.

**WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS:**

* **Building Sarvoham as a purpose driven employer of choice for Talent:** Sarvoham has built a reliable and credible rescue and rehabilitation model since 2017. The Foundation is looking for an experienced member as the Talent Acquisition Specialist & HR Business Partner to attract, engage, build sustainable and meaningful relationships with individuals who resonate with the Foundation’s purpose to build a society that provides a ‘respectable’ life to all animal species.
* **Build a Talent community with a Stewardship mindset:** Working closely with the CEO, Board, leadership team and civil society organisations, the incumbent will cultivate meaningful relationships that generate talent in the form of full-time employees and volunteers who inspire collective action and expand the Foundation's impact across India.
* **Design the People, Culture and Talent Community:** Work closely with the leadership team at Sarvoham to design, implement and lead the talent attraction and retention strategy at Sarvoham that can attract desired talent across technical and functional requirements with a sense of purpose and commitment to contribute positively to perpetuity of Sarvoham's veterinary and sanctuary missions.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

**End to End Talent Acquisition (50%):** Spearhead end to end talent acquisition across roles for the foundation including but not limited to:

* Veterinary professionals
* Animal caregivers
* Shelter and Sanctuary staff
* Field rescue teams
* Fundraising professionals
* Storytelling, Communications and Branding roles
* Finance, HR and Administration in addition to Leadership and Specialist positions

***Responsibilities:***

* Partner with the leadership team at Sarvoham to project manpower requirements.
* Design job descriptions and recruitment campaigns.
* Source candidates through LinkedIn, Naukri, Indeed, social media, referrals, universities and professional networks.
* Build available talent pipelines that align with the vision, mission and purpose of Sarvoham for critical positions.
* Screen resumes and conduct competency and skills assessments including initial interviews.
* Conduct reference and background checks for shortlisted candidates.
* Own the candidate engagement and communication engagement throughout the recruitment process.
* Prepare letters of intent, letters post compensation and fitment assessment within approved guidelines.
* Ensure an exceptional candidate experience from recruitment and onboarding to across the employee life-cycle.

**HR Business Partnering (50%):** Partner with the leadership team at Sarvoham to support the employee life-cycle including but not limited to the following:

* Manage employee lifecycle processes such as joining, onboarding, transfers, confirmations, attendance, leave, documentation and exit formalities adhering to mandated organisational policies and practices.
* Maintain accuracy and integrity of employee records, HR files and HRIS data.
* Organise meaningful employee engagement initiatives including learning and development.
* Design the Performance Management policy in line with the organisational philosophy, monitor performance trends and implement necessary corrective actions as per organisational policy.
* Introduce and support wellness and recognition programmes.
* Design and implement HR policies, including the code of conduct, grievance re-dressal, whistleblower and other policies aligned with organisational values and statutory regulations.
* Address employee queries and grievances, initiating corrective and disciplinary measures as required.
* Partner on Strategic Projects at Sarvoham including volunteering for animal welfare activities and programs.

**SUCCESS MEASURES:**

**Community Engagement & Social Impact:**

* Build partnerships with agencies and groups for building a network of veterinarians’ , NGOs, and volunteers that empower communities to become active participants in animal welfare, environmental sustainability, and community resilience.

**Candidate & Employee NPS:**

* Build Sarvoham as a brand an employer brand that places employee experience at the core of it's operations that drives genuine compassion for employees to become active participants in animal welfare, environmental sustainability, and community resilience.

**Candidate & Employee Experience:**

* Build credibility for Sarvoham as an employer of choice with a vision that resonates and attracts employee acquisition, sustainable retention and development to become active participants in animal welfare, environmental sustainability, and community resilience.

**CANDIDATE PROFILE:**

The ideal candidate is a purpose-driven individual who combines strategic thinking with a blend of compassion, influence, and execution, engaging prospective employees and communities, while inspiring internal teams around a shared purpose.

* **Work Experience:** 0-2 years of progressive experience in talent acquisition and business partnering. Freshers are welcome to apply.
* **Proven Track Record:** of fulfillment and employee satisfaction.
* **Operational Skills:** Proven ability to recruit and design, people thinking policies and processes with psychometric assessments, assignments and data-driven management.

**PREFERRED BACKGROUNDS:**

* Ability to become a preferred partner for candidates and employees.

* Experience in NGOs, healthcare, veterinary services, social impact organisations as a volunteer or employee is an advantage.
* Experience hiring across multiple functions and job roles is preferred.
* Practices and promotes a life-style that is animal friendly.

**WHY JOIN SARVOHAM:**

We are on a mission to establish equity, inclusion, and compassion for animals in society, so that they can lead a fulfilling and respectable life. We are looking for a clinician who resonates with this mission and believes that their experience, skills, and judgment can genuinely change outcomes for the animals who need it most — leading by example, and helping build a shelter medicine practice that will sustain for generations to come.

Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.

### **You Are**

You have spent years building simulation models that bridge hardware and software, and you understand that a virtual prototype is only valuable if it helps a software engineer start writing code six months before silicon arrives. The difference between a model that accelerates a project and one that sits unused is usually in the details you caught early, the peripheral behavior you got right, or the bus protocol you modeled accurately enough that Linux actually boots.

Working in C++ and SystemC feels natural to you. You do not need a complete specification to start modeling, you talk to the right people, fill in the gaps, and build something that works well enough to unblock the next team. You have debugged enough bring-up issues to know that the problem is rarely where it first appears, and you are the kind of engineer who digs until you find the actual root cause.

Mentoring matters to you. When a junior engineer gets stuck on a tricky integration issue, you do not just fix it, you walk them through the why so they can handle it next time. At Synopsys, you will work on virtual prototyping platforms that power early software development for some of the most advanced chips being designed today.

### **What You'll Be Doing**

* Design and develop virtual prototypes for SoC, MCU, and ECU platforms across automotive, datacenter, AI, and mobile applications using SystemC-based modeling frameworks
* Model, integrate, and test peripherals including timers, DMA controllers, interrupt controllers, and communication interfaces within complex system-level platforms
* Collaborate with IP teams, architects, and customers to define modeling requirements and create Electronic System Level specifications
* Debug and resolve technical issues across hardware models and software stacks, ensuring virtual platforms support Linux, Android, AutoSAR, and embedded application bring-up
* Mentor junior engineers and consultants through platform creation, validation workflows, and software integration activities

### **The Impact You Will Have**

* Accelerate time-to-market for next-generation automotive, AI, datacenter, and mobile products by enabling software development months before silicon availability
* Improve software and hardware integration quality by providing high-fidelity simulation environments that catch issues early in the development cycle
* Enable customer success by delivering robust virtual prototypes that support complex bring-up scenarios and real-world software workloads
* Build the technical capability of the team by mentoring engineers and sharing knowledge that elevates the quality of future platforms

description:
**Your role at Dynatrace**
--------------------------

**What’s the role?**

As a Dynatrace Solution Engineer, you will be a key member of the Dynatrace sales engine and will be responsible for providing excellent technical support to the sales team. You will be the expert on Dynatrace and all facets of Advanced Observability. Within this exciting role, you will be responsible for executing great demos which demonstrate the Dynatrace unique approach in solving the customer’s pain, executing and managing POCs onsite and remote, building key relationships with Dynatrace’s customers and completing RFIs & RFPs. You will also work across teams including Dynatrace’s innovation labs, Dynatrace’s Expert Services consultants, CSMs and marketing.

  

**About you:**

To ensure your success as a Solution Engineer at Dynatrace, you need to be an ambitious, confident and self-motivated individual, with previous SE experience or another technical customer facing role. You need to be passionate about innovative technology, technical sales and articulating value to customers and prospects. In addition, we are also looking for:

* An excellent team player, with the ability to work across all disciplines.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate technical value into business value.
* Previous 3 – 5 years of experience with observability or application performance management technologies and techniques.
* Ability to troubleshoot technical issues to produce a working outcome and be able to manage this process.
* Ability to manage a number of projects simultaneously, work with a number of different sales people and support other SEs where needed.
* Must have a strong desire to grow professionally, adapt to an ever-changing environment and are coachable.
* Must be able to travel up to 30% of the time

**Responsibilities:**

* Evangelize Dynatrace’s product offerings during international trade shows and at key customer account meetings to promote new and expanded business.
* Partner with sales representatives to identify new sales opportunities as well as incremental sales opportunities within existing accounts.
* As part of the solution engineering team participate in proof of concept (PoC) creation and cloud architecture discussions, leading the technical solution evaluation portion in support of sales opportunities either directly or through channel partners for multiple POCs.
* Present Dynatrace’s vision to our customers C-suite executives.
* Provide technical guidance in the Discovery, Solution Evaluation, and Solution Proposal stages of the opportunity sales cycle.
* Present on-stage demonstrations providing insight and context to our customers during key marketing events. Either at Dynatrace sponsored industry events or partner sponsored events, ensure key demonstrations are delivered by you or a team member at demonstration booths.
* Gather, qualify and provide feedback from customers to Product Management to improve Dynatrace’s market share and meet the market needs.
* Not only work with internal sales team, but also with partners, supporting their team in the customers and being a technical point of contact for them (trusted advisor/technical coach).
* Position might be filled at a higher level based on candidate experience.

**What will help you succeed**
------------------------------

**Minimum Requirements:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent education or experience required.
* 3 years of experience within the observability space.

**Preferred Requirements:**

* Experience with web technologies such as HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
* Experience with programming / scripting side technologies such as Java, .NET, PHP, Go, Node.js and database.
* Advance knowledge of Operating Systems (OS) including Windows and Linux.
* Experience with DevOps or Site Reliability Engineering practices Knowledge with cloud platforms, including AWS, Azure or GCP.
* Experience with modern technologies like containers, Kubernetes / OpenShift, Serverless functions, and CI/CD pipelines.
* Experience with automation like Ansible, Puppet, Terraform, etc.

**Why you will love being a Dynatracer**
----------------------------------------

* Dynatrace is a leader in unified observability and security.
* We provide a culture of excellence with competitive compensation packages designed to recognize and reward performance.
* Our employees work with the largest cloud providers, including AWS, Microsoft, and Google Cloud, and other leading partners worldwide to create strategic alliances.
* You'll get to work at the forefront of innovation with Dynatrace Intelligence—the industry's first agentic operations system. Bringing together deterministic and agentic AI, it helps teams understand what's happening, why it matters, and what to do next— automatically.
* Over 50% of the Fortune 100 companies are current customers of Dynatrace.

**Compensation and Rewards**
----------------------------

**Note to Recruiters and Agencies** : Thank you for your interest in Dynatrace. Please note that **we do not accept unsolicited agency resumes** —do not forward them via our website or directly to Dynatrace employees. Dynatrace will not pay fees for unsolicited resumes, and any resumes received this way will be considered the property of Dynatrace.

**Benefits and work-life perks**
--------------------------------

We offer best-in-class core rewards, including paid time off, financial security benefits, retirement savings plans, and health insurance. Beyond that, you’ll get other benefits and work-life perks designed to make your ride with us even more rewarding.

#### **Mental health support**

Our Employee Assistance Program, powered by Telus Health, offers support for you and your family members.

#### **Wellness Days**

Four company-designated extra paid days off for you to recharge batteries.

#### **Flexibility**

Our hybrid working model and flexible working hours offer you the flexibility you need.

#### **AI-driven workflows**

Use AI as your daily teammate to automate tasks and focus on what matters.

#### **Learn & develop**

Company-wide learning perks, designated team's learning days, and more.

#### **Volunteering day**

A day of paid volunteer time to support a community or cause you care about.

#### **Regular team events**

We host Global Culture Parties, Family & Friends at Work Day, Global Breakfasts, Green Weeks, Pride Month, and beyond!

#### **International vibe**

Most of our offices and teams are proudly multicultural. English is our shared language, but we embrace and learn from each other's cultures.

Rewards vary depending on your employment type. Some benefits and perks also differ by location — explore your city to see what’s available there.

**About Dynatrace**
-------------------

Dynatrace (NYSE: DT) is the leading AI-powered observability and security platform. We're advancing observability for today's digital businesses, helping transform modern digital ecosystems' complexity into powerful business assets.

Our AI-driven insights cut through the noise, allowing customers to focus on what truly matters by automating manual tasks and resolving issues with pinpoint accuracy. Dynatrace offers simplicity, clarity, and reliability at scale to ensure teams can make informed decisions, minimize downtime, and drive their business forward with confidence.

Here is a recruitment-ready JD for an **Interventional Cardiologist** at ONUS Robotic Hospitals.

Job Description – Interventional Cardiologist

**Organization:** ONUS Robotic Hospitals  
**Department:** Cardiology  
**Position:** Interventional Cardiologist  
**Location:** Hyderabad  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time / Consultant  
**Reporting To:** Medical Director / Clinical Head / Hospital Management

Job Purpose

ONUS Robotic Hospitals is looking for an experienced and clinically competent **Interventional Cardiologist** to lead and deliver comprehensive cardiac care, including outpatient cardiology services, emergency cardiac management, inpatient care, non-invasive evaluation, and interventional cardiology procedures.

The Interventional Cardiologist will be responsible for diagnosing and treating cardiovascular diseases, performing coronary and peripheral interventions as per credentials and hospital privileges, managing acute cardiac emergencies, and contributing to the growth of the Cardiology department.

The role requires strong clinical judgment, procedural expertise, ethical practice, patient-centered communication, and close coordination with Critical Care, Emergency, Radiology, Nursing, and other specialties.

Key Responsibilities1. Outpatient Cardiology Services

Evaluate and manage patients presenting with:

* Chest pain
* Breathlessness
* Palpitations
* Hypertension
* Coronary artery disease
* Heart failure
* Valvular heart disease
* Arrhythmias
* Dyslipidemia
* Cardiomyopathies
* Syncope
* Peripheral vascular disease
* Post-angioplasty and post-CABG follow-up

Provide evidence-based diagnosis, treatment planning, follow-up, and preventive cardiac care.

2. Interventional Cardiology Procedures

Perform interventional procedures based on qualifications, credentialing, and hospital privileges, including:

* Coronary angiography
* Coronary angioplasty / PCI
* Primary PCI for acute myocardial infarction
* Complex PCI where appropriately credentialed
* Temporary pacemaker insertion
* Permanent pacemaker implantation where privileged
* Peripheral angiography and interventions where applicable
* Structural or advanced interventional procedures where credentialed

Ensure strict adherence to procedural safety standards and appropriate patient selection.

3. Cath Lab Responsibilities

Provide clinical leadership and supervision in the Cath Lab.

Responsibilities include:

* Pre-procedure patient evaluation
* Reviewing investigations
* Obtaining informed consent
* Procedure planning
* Ensuring readiness of Cath Lab team
* Monitoring procedural safety
* Managing complications
* Post-procedure orders
* Post-procedure patient review
* Documentation of procedure notes
* Implant and consumable documentation

4. Acute Cardiac Emergency Management

Manage cardiac emergencies including:

* Acute coronary syndrome
* STEMI
* NSTEMI
* Cardiogenic shock
* Acute heart failure
* Life-threatening arrhythmias
* Hypertensive emergencies
* Cardiac arrest
* Pulmonary edema

Work closely with Emergency and ICU teams to ensure rapid diagnosis and treatment.

5. Inpatient Cardiology Care

Provide comprehensive management for admitted cardiac patients.

Responsibilities include:

* Daily rounds
* Treatment planning
* Medication review
* Investigation review
* Procedure planning
* Clinical escalation
* Discharge planning
* Follow-up recommendations
* Multidisciplinary coordination

6. Pre-Operative Cardiac Evaluation

Provide cardiac fitness and risk assessment for patients undergoing:

* Orthopaedic surgery
* Robotic joint replacement
* General surgery
* Neurosurgery
* Other elective and emergency procedures

Recommend optimization and peri-operative cardiac management where required.

7. Preventive Cardiology

Develop and support preventive cardiac care for patients with risk factors such as:

* Hypertension
* Diabetes
* Obesity
* Dyslipidemia
* Smoking history
* Family history of cardiovascular disease
* Sedentary lifestyle

Encourage evidence-based lifestyle modification and risk-factor management.

8. Diagnostic Cardiology Coordination

Interpret or supervise cardiac investigations as appropriate, including:

* ECG
* 2D Echocardiography
* TMT
* Holter monitoring
* Ambulatory blood pressure monitoring
* Cardiac CT / CT coronary angiography where relevant
* Other advanced cardiac investigations

Coordinate with Radiology and diagnostic teams when multimodality evaluation is required.

9. Patient Counseling

Clearly explain:

* Diagnosis
* Treatment options
* Need for angiography or intervention
* Benefits and risks of procedures
* Alternatives
* Expected recovery
* Medication requirements
* Lifestyle modification
* Follow-up plan

Ensure informed and ethical decision-making without unnecessary procedures.

10. Clinical Documentation

Maintain complete and timely documentation including:

* OP consultation notes
* Admission notes
* Daily progress notes
* Procedure notes
* Consent documentation
* Discharge summaries
* Medication plans
* Follow-up instructions

Documentation should meet hospital, insurance, medico-legal, and accreditation requirements.

11. Multidisciplinary Coordination

Work closely with:

* Emergency Medicine
* Critical Care
* Anaesthesia
* Internal Medicine
* Radiology
* Neurology
* Nephrology
* Orthopaedics
* General Surgery
* Nursing
* Cath Lab technicians
* Physiotherapy and Rehabilitation

Participate in multidisciplinary decision-making for complex patients.

12. Quality & Patient Safety

Actively participate in quality initiatives related to:

* Door-to-balloon time
* Cath Lab safety
* Contrast-related complications
* Bleeding complications
* Medication safety
* Infection prevention
* Mortality and morbidity review
* Readmission rates
* Emergency response
* Code Blue management

Review adverse events and contribute to corrective and preventive action.

13. Clinical Protocol Development

Support development and implementation of protocols for:

* Acute coronary syndrome
* STEMI pathway
* Chest pain management
* Heart failure
* Hypertension
* Anticoagulation
* Post-PCI care
* Cardiac emergency management

Ensure protocols remain aligned with accepted clinical guidelines.

14. Department Development

Contribute to growth of the Cardiology department through:

* OPD development
* Cath Lab utilization
* Emergency cardiac services
* Health check programs
* Preventive cardiology
* Referral network development
* Corporate and community screening programs
* Clinical education initiatives

Any outreach activity should remain medically appropriate and compliant with professional standards.

15. Training & Academic Responsibilities

Participate in:

* Nursing education
* Emergency team training
* Cath Lab staff training
* Case discussions
* Clinical audits
* CME activities
* Journal clubs
* Morbidity and mortality meetings

Support continuous improvement in cardiac care quality.

Key Performance Indicators – KPIs

Performance may be evaluated based on:

* OPD volumes
* Inpatient clinical outcomes
* Cath Lab procedural volumes
* Door-to-balloon time
* Procedural complication rates
* Appropriate use of interventions
* Documentation quality
* Patient satisfaction
* Emergency response quality
* Readmission rates
* Clinical audit participation
* Protocol compliance
* Department growth
* Referral development
* Quality and safety indicators

Clinical quality and patient safety should always take priority over procedural volume.

Required Qualifications

* **MBBS**
* **MD / DNB – General Medicine**
* **DM / DrNB – Cardiology**
* Valid Medical Council registration
* Appropriate Cath Lab / interventional cardiology training and credentials

Preferred Experience

* Experience as an Interventional Cardiologist in a multispeciality or tertiary-care hospital preferred
* Independent experience in coronary angiography and angioplasty is desirable
* Experience in emergency PCI and acute cardiac care preferred
* Additional experience in complex coronary interventions will be an advantage

Required Skills

The candidate should have:

* Strong clinical cardiology knowledge
* Interventional skills
* Emergency cardiac management ability
* Cath Lab decision-making skills
* Good patient communication
* Strong clinical documentation
* Multidisciplinary coordination ability
* Leadership skills
* Ethical decision-making
* Ability to work under pressure

Candidate Attributes

The ideal candidate should be:

* Clinically sound
* Patient focused
* Ethical
* Decisive during emergencies
* Calm under pressure
* Strong in teamwork
* Responsible
* Evidence driven
* Quality focused
* Committed to continuous professional development

Core Accountability

The Interventional Cardiologist should follow one core principle:

**“Provide timely, evidence-based and ethical cardiac care, using intervention only when clinically appropriate and always prioritizing patient safety and outcomes.”**

The role will be accountable for:

**Consultation → Diagnosis → Emergency Management → Intervention → Inpatient Care → Recovery → Prevention → Follow-Up.**

You will guide complex engagements from requirements and design through configuration or development, testing, cutover, go-live, and stabilization. Your work will connect planned schedules, recorded time, absence transactions, and downstream Payroll processing to support consistent business outcomes and production readiness. Working with geographically distributed clients and functional, technical, integration, security, data, and Payroll teams, you will resolve cross-service dependencies and explain design options and trade-offs. You will govern rules, formulas, approvals, testing, performance, and solution quality while addressing relevant security, Redwood, AI, and Workforce Health and Safety implications. The role suits an experienced architect or domain lead who can demonstrate personal implementation ownership, mentor consultants, and communicate workstream risks and decisions to project leadership.

The role supports clients across all geographies. Hiring location, official grade, final experience range, employment model, hybrid attendance, travel expectations, and required overlap with client working hours will be confirmed during recruitment.

  

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Own integrated Workforce Management architecture from requirements and design through configuration or development, testing, cutover, go-live, and stabilization to support successful delivery.
* Lead requirements and architecture workshops; evaluate design options against business fit, maintainability, performance, security, user experience, and delivery complexity.
* Resolve dependencies across Workforce Scheduling, time capture and calculation, absence processing, and Payroll, including processing sequence, retrospective corrections, reconciliation, and exception ownership.
* Govern business rules, Fast Formulas, validations, approvals, and exception handling to deliver consistent outcomes across services.
* Lead cross-stream design reviews with functional, technical, integration, security, data, and Payroll teams; address relevant Workforce Health and Safety, security, Redwood, and AI implications.
* Define and govern integration, regression, exception, performance, and user acceptance testing across services to validate end-to-end business outcomes.
* Establish solution quality criteria, review delivery evidence, and drive resolution of functional issues and design defects to meet agreed quality expectations.
* Review migration and integration designs, data ownership, error handling, recovery, reconciliation, and cutover dependencies to establish production readiness.
* Maintain design decisions, dependency maps, documentation, and configuration or development standards; demonstrate the integrated solution and explain business and operational implications.
* Guide delivery teams, mentor consultants, and communicate workstream risks, dependencies, and decisions to project leadership to support coordinated delivery.

**Skills - Mandatory**
----------------------

**Experience**

* 8–20 years of relevant experience.
* 2–3 completed end-to-end Oracle Fusion HCM implementations in Workforce Management, delivered as architect or domain lead.
* Demonstrated personal ownership from requirements and design through configuration or development, testing, cutover, and go-live, supported by specific implementation examples.

**Oracle Products**

* Absence Management and Time and Labor: Ability to architect complex solutions spanning both services, with demonstrated depth in Workforce Scheduling.
* Absence Management: Expertise governing eligibility, entitlement, accrual and qualification rules, balances, approvals, and exceptions.
* Time and Labor: Expertise governing time capture, calculation, validation, approval, transfer, and correction processes.
* Workforce Scheduling: Ability to translate requirements and constraints into integrated designs covering worker availability, planned schedules, recorded time, absence, and downstream processing; validate normal, change, and exception scenarios.

**Functional Skills**

* Ability to assess worker and assignment changes, effective dates, work schedules, and retrospective corrections across the integrated solution.
* Understanding of downstream Payroll impacts, processing sequence, corrections, reconciliation, and exception ownership, together with relevant Workforce Health and Safety dependencies.

**Technical Skills**

* Strong understanding of Fast Formula design, review, troubleshooting, and validation; ability to govern rules, approvals, validations, and exceptions across services.
* Ability to govern integration boundaries, data ownership, error handling, recovery requirements, testing, performance, and solution quality across integrated business processes.
* Ability to review Oracle Fusion HCM security, including roles, data access, and access across integrated processes.
* Ability to review Redwood implications for configuration, user journeys, extensibility, and testing, and assess AI use cases, data access, human review, and validation of generated outputs.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Ability to present design options, explain trade-offs, lead architecture discussions and cross-stream design reviews, and demonstrate business outcomes and operational implications.
* Strong documentation, stakeholder communication, and problem-solving skills.

**Leadership**

* Demonstrated delivery leadership, with the ability to guide teams, mentor consultants, and communicate workstream risks and decisions to project leadership.

**Good to Have**
----------------

* Experience delivering multi-country or complex enterprise Workforce Management implementations.
* Architecture ownership involving integrations, migration, and reconciliation across scheduling, time, absence, and Payroll.

title: Head HR
description:
JOB DESCRIPTIONPosition: HR Head – Plant

**Company:** Let's Try Foods  
**Location:** Kundli Plant, Sonipat, Haryana  
**Department:** Human Resources  
**Reporting To:** Plant Head / Corporate HR Head  
**Experience:** 8–12 Years  
**Industry Preference:** FMCG / Food Manufacturing / Manufacturing Industry

Job Purpose

To lead and manage all HR and personnel functions at the Kundli manufacturing plant, ensuring smooth HR operations, effective manpower planning, statutory compliance, employee engagement, industrial relations, and workforce productivity. The role will be responsible for developing and implementing HR practices aligned with the company's business and manufacturing objectives.

Key Responsibilities

**1. HR Operations & Administration**

* Manage complete plant HR operations, including joining, onboarding, confirmation, transfers, separation and exit formalities.
* Maintain employee records, attendance, leave management and HR documentation.
* Develop and implement HR policies and procedures at the plant.
* Ensure smooth coordination between plant management and corporate HR.

**2. Manpower Planning & Recruitment**

* Plan and manage manpower requirements for production, warehouse, quality, maintenance and other plant departments.
* Handle recruitment of permanent, contractual and temporary manpower.
* Coordinate with recruitment agencies and labour contractors.
* Ensure timely deployment of manpower as per production requirements.

**3. Industrial Relations & Employee Management**

* Manage industrial relations and maintain a healthy relationship with workers and employees.
* Handle worker grievances, disciplinary matters, misconduct and conflict resolution.
* Manage labour contractors and contract workforce.
* Ensure effective communication between management and shop-floor employees.
* Handle union-related matters, if applicable.

**4. Statutory Compliance & Labour Laws**

* Ensure compliance with applicable labour laws and statutory regulations.
* Manage PF, ESIC, Bonus, Gratuity, Minimum Wages, Professional Tax (where applicable), and other statutory requirements.
* Ensure timely maintenance of statutory registers, returns, records and documentation.
* Coordinate with government authorities, labour inspectors and external consultants.
* Ensure compliance with factory-related labour regulations and audits.

**5. Payroll & Attendance Management**

* Supervise monthly payroll processing for permanent and contractual employees.
* Ensure accurate attendance, overtime, leave and wage calculations.
* Monitor salary disbursement and statutory deductions.
* Coordinate with Finance and Accounts for payroll-related matters.

**6. Training & Development**

* Identify training needs for workers, supervisors and staff.
* Organise induction, safety awareness, skill development and behavioural training.
* Develop training plans to improve employee efficiency and productivity.
* Maintain training records and evaluate training effectiveness.

**7. Performance Management & Employee Engagement**

* Implement performance appraisal and employee evaluation processes.
* Drive employee engagement, welfare activities and retention initiatives.
* Develop reward and recognition programmes.
* Promote a positive and disciplined working environment.

**8. Factory Compliance & Safety Coordination**

* Coordinate with the EHS and factory teams to ensure workplace safety and employee welfare.
* Support factory audits, customer audits and statutory inspections.
* Ensure compliance with applicable workplace health, safety and welfare requirements.
* Coordinate with the concerned departments for implementation of corrective actions.

Key Skills & Competencies

* Strong knowledge of HR operations and labour laws.
* Excellent knowledge of industrial relations and factory HR management.
* Experience in handling large blue-collar and contractual workforces.
* Strong leadership, communication and negotiation skills.
* Good knowledge of MS Excel and HRMS.
* Ability to manage employee grievances and disciplinary issues.
* Strong coordination and problem-solving abilities.

Educational Qualification

* MBA / PGDM in Human Resource Management.
* Graduation in any discipline.
* Specialisation in Industrial Relations or Labour Laws will be an added advantage.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Manpower availability and fulfilment.
* Employee attrition and retention rate.
* Payroll accuracy and timely salary processing.
* Statutory compliance and audit performance.
* Reduction in absenteeism.
* Employee grievance resolution.
* Training effectiveness and workforce productivity.
* Contract labour management and cost control.

Preferred Candidate Profile

* 8–12 years of overall HR experience, preferably in FMCG or food manufacturing.
* Minimum 4–5 years of experience in independently handling plant HR operations.
* Strong exposure to blue-collar workforce management and industrial relations.
* Experience in managing contract labour, statutory compliance and factory HR operations.
* Should be capable of independently managing the complete HR function at the Kundli plant.

Pay: ₹1,500,000.00 - ₹2,000,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person
